works.title: bioLogic
works.description: Natto bacteria cells printed onto thin films expand and contract with humidity, so a sportswear garment opens flaps over the skin when the wearer sweats and closes them as it dries.
works.description_zh: 印在薄膜上的纳豆菌细胞会随湿度膨胀和收缩：穿着者出汗时，运动服上的小翼片自动张开透气，汗干后再合上。
works.idea_en: Living cells as the actuator: the garment reacts to the body because the bacteria react to moisture.
works.idea_zh: 让活细胞当驱动器：衣服之所以能回应身体，是因为细菌在回应湿气。
works.method: Bacillus subtilis natto cells are bio-printed on a latex layer; the cell layer absorbs and loses water much faster than latex, so the bilayer bends reversibly with relative humidity.
works.method_zh: 把纳豆枯草芽孢杆菌生物打印在乳胶层上；细胞层吸水和失水都远快于乳胶，双层膜因此随相对湿度可逆地弯曲。

paper.title: bioLogic: Natto Cells as Nanoactuators for Shape Changing Interfaces
